1.explanation:
- upload/index.md & index.en-us.md: describe the itemRender prop and default remove logic (props and expected behavior).
- upload/adaptor/index.jsx: contains the core rendering logic for upload items, including how the default remove button is injected and how itemRender overrides it.
- upload/theme/index.jsx: defines the CSS / icon styles for the remove (delete) button so you can see how it’s shown or hidden.
- upload/demo/base.md: shows the default Upload usage with remove functionality—useful to compare behavior before and after applying itemRender.
- upload/demo/image.md: demonstrates a typical image upload scenario and may illustrate custom previews; helpful for reproducing the bug with images.

Together these documents cover the Upload API, examples, rendering implementation, and styling needed to understand why itemRender suppresses the delete button and how to restore it when customizing items.
1.bug_scenario: The user applied the Upload component’s itemRender prop to fully customize how each uploaded item is displayed, but after providing a custom itemRender function the default delete (remove) button no longer appears. In the screenshot, the top list (standard Upload usage) shows the IMG.png thumbnail with an “×” icon on hover to remove the file. In the bottom list (using itemRender), only the custom thumbnail and a timestamp overlay are rendered; there is no delete icon, so the user cannot remove the file.
